levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري

notes: «بإسناده يرفعه إلى» is a gap (rule 8), kept as an unnamed link; «وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter of Ahmad ibn Muhammad.
The Imam is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he stays narrator, not imam_in_text; the editor's «رضي الله عنه» is left out.
